Recurday

Terms

Last updated November 17, 2026.

Recurday is a free app for family traditions. You do not have to pay or buy anything to use it. The software is offered as-is, under the MIT license, without a promise that it will always be up.

You are responsible for what you add. Only upload photos your family has the right to keep here. Recurday is photos only.

Photos are private to your family and to people you give a link to, as explained in Privacy. A family link works like a house key: anyone who has it can see and add photos. Keep your passcode and links to yourselves.

If the photos matter to you, use Save a copy to keep a zip on your own device. Hosting may change or pause. We may slow or stop use that looks like abuse, including too many login tries or uploads.

Privacy explains what we keep and how to delete it. The code is open source on GitHub.
